correctness.rationale: At N=3,M=2,T=1/2, the stated smooth ODE has E=(1/2,2c/b) in the unit square iff 0<c<b/2. Direct Jacobian has entries 0,b/(8eps),-beta*r*(1-r*)/2,0, yielding nonzero imaginary pair. The global involution R(x,r)=(1-x,r) satisfies F(Rz)=-DR F(z), not merely an approximately vanishing Lyapunov coefficient. Initial conditions on Fix(R) have a transverse second section crossing near pi/omega by rescaled linearization and IFT; reversibility returns after twice this time, producing a local annulus of periodic orbits. Symmetric time reversal gives mean x=1/2 and cov(x,r)=0. Average the exact log-odds derivative to get 2b E[r x(1-x)]=c, hence mean r-r*=4E[r(x-1/2)^2]>0. Exact symbolic Jacobian/reflection plus one independent numerical periodic orbit were checked. No global period-annulus or noisy finite population claim follows.
